checks.title: A missing value could be coerced to zero
checks.why: Number(null) is 0 and Number.isFinite(0) is true, so a guard written this way accepts an ABSENT value as a real zero. This exact line shape rendered every asset green and 'at or above the gate' when the gate could not be read.
checks.fix: Check for null/undefined/'' BEFORE coercing, then Number() the survivor.

checks.title: Inline script may run before freshness.js has loaded
checks.why: freshness.js is loaded with `defer`, which executes AFTER the parser reaches an inline end-of-body script but BEFORE DOMContentLoaded. A page that calls its loader immediately draws its FIRST paint with window.SEFresh undefined, so every age renders as unknown until the next refresh quietly hides it.
checks.fix: Wrap the first load in the same guard freshness.js uses on itself: if (document.readyState === 'loading') addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', load); else load();

checks.title: External text may reach innerHTML unescaped
checks.why: Calendar titles, analyst text and log lines come from feeds and files this system does not control. Interpolated into innerHTML without escaping, they are an injection surface — and one was found live in the daily-plan calendar.
checks.fix: Escape at the boundary: esc(value) / escapeHtml(value) before concatenating.

checks.title: A CSS class is defined and never used
checks.why: A styled element nothing renders is a state the page cannot reach. .no-screenshot was styled for months while a missing chart rendered as nothing at all, which is indistinguishable from a page that never had charts.
checks.fix: Either render the state the class was written for, or note in the CSS why it is kept.

checks.title: Page is missing a shared shell include
checks.why: theme.css carries the one palette and nav.css/nav.js the one rail. A page without them renders its own colours and cannot be navigated to from anywhere — which is how /architecture ended up with exactly one inbound link in the whole product.
checks.fix: Add the standard <head> block: theme.css, nav.css, nav.js defer, freshness.*
